# Maximum Pixel — Complete Studio & Pricing Reference (Effective 24 Nov 2026)

Website: https://www.maximumpixel.online
Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 78787 36798
Email: info@maximumpixel.online | hello.maximumpixel@gmail.com
Currency: Indian Rupees (₹), no GST shown.

## Core Services
- **01 Video Production**: Professional video shoots for brands, businesses, products and campaigns.
- **02 Video Editing**: Editing, pacing, sound design, colour correction and final finishing.
- **03 Complete Shoot + Edit**: A complete production process, from the camera to the final export.
- **04 Creative Direction**: Visual planning, concepts, references and storytelling.

## Rate Card Summary (Effective 24 November 2026)
1. **Video Shoot and Edit (Reels, 30–40 sec)**:
   - Reel, shoot + edit: ₹1,700 / reel
   - Reel, shoot only: ₹1,000 / reel
   - Product video (15–30 sec): ₹1,000 / product
   - Video shoot, half day (up to 4 hrs): ₹2,500
   - Video shoot, full day (up to 8 hrs): ₹4,500
2. **Editing Only & Post Creation**:
   - Reel editing (30–40 sec): ₹800 / reel
   - Photo editing: ₹40 / photo (₹30 / photo for 25+ photos)
   - Single image post / Carousel post (3–5 slides): ₹200 / ₹400
3. **Product Photography (Handicraft & Catalog)**:
   - Single product (4 edited photos): ₹400
   - 10 products (40 photos): ₹3,500
   - 25 products (100 photos): ₹8,000
   - 50 products (200 photos): ₹14,000
   - Extra photo of same product: ₹100 / photo
4. **Lifestyle, Brand & Artisan Photoshoots**:
   - Mini shoot (1 hr, up to 10 photos): ₹1,200
   - Half day (up to 4 hrs, up to 25 photos): ₹3,000
   - Full day (up to 8 hrs, up to 50 photos): ₹5,500
   - Props styling support: ₹300 per shoot
5. **Social Posts with Shoot**:
   - Single image post: ₹300 | Carousel (3–5 slides): ₹500 | Post shot with a reel: ₹150
6. **Monthly Packages**:
   - Shoot + Edit: Starter (6 reels + 4 free posts): ₹8,100 | Growth (12 reels + 6 free posts): ₹15,000 | Pro (20 reels + 10 free posts): ₹24,500
   - Editing-Only: Starter (6 reels): ₹4,500 | Growth (12 reels): ₹8,400 | Pro (20 reels): ₹13,000
7. **Standard Terms**:
   - Delivery: Reels 3–5 days after shoot (2–3 days editing only); Photos 2–3 days after shoot.
   - Revisions: 1 round included per job.
   - Payment: Monthly packages 100% in advance; single jobs 50% advance, 50% on delivery.
